🔥 The fire settles. the woman in her 40s, with restless hands has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Two knobs on glass-still water, watching — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Violet breathes "And you're still standing." Diana says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
